lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: RIKU STOP! [beat] If you pull that lever right now the whole floor is going to collapse on top of us!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Relax Nix [beat] I saw this in a video once and I’m telling you there is a hidden compartment behind these old dusty books.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You always think life is a video game [beat] but we are literally in Grandpa’s attic and he will kill us if we break anything.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Look at this gold-plated handle [beat] do you really think Dada just keeps regular old junk in a place this well hidden?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It looks like a safe from the eighteen hundreds [beat] and why is there a weird ticking sound coming from the inside of the wall?

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: It’s probably just some ancient clock mechanism [beat] or maybe a countdown to the biggest jackpot of our lives!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Boys! [beat] I told you to stay away from the north wing of the attic because the floorboards are completely rotten!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Sorry Grandpa! [beat] We were just looking for my old skateboard but then Riku found this crazy looking metal door.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Get away from there right now [beat] that is not a safe and you definitely do not want to see what is locked inside.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Don't try to scare us Dada [beat] I know you’re just trying to keep all the family gold for yourself and your secret bank account.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: You think this is about money? [beat] That door was sealed fifty years ago to keep something from getting out, not to keep things in.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The ticking just stopped [beat] and I think I hear something scratching against the metal from the other side.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some family secrets are better left buried [beat] especially when they start breathing back at you.
